articles.title: Air India Extends Saudi Suspensions: Riyadh, Dammam to November 30
articles.excerpt: Air India and Air India Express will keep Riyadh and Dammam flights suspended until November 30, 2026 and Jeddah until November 21, with free rescheduling or a full refund for eligible bookings issued on or before November 10.
articles.image_caption: Saudi
articles.nri_angle: The extended suspension affects Indian workers, families and Umrah travellers who rely on direct Air India group flights between India and Riyadh, Dammam and Jeddah.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Jaipur Monuments Draw Bigger Crowds as Post-Diwali Tourist Surge Builds
articles.excerpt: Amer Fort jumped from 8,186 to 10,923 visitors in a day as Diwali trips extended and winter arrivals began. With the Pushkar Fair opening November 19, Rajasthan's peak season is already under way.
articles.image_caption: Amer Fort in Jaipur, Rajasthan. The fort received 10,923 visitors on November 10, according to Tourism Department figures reported by ANI, as Jaipur's post-Diwali tourist surge built toward the winter season.
articles.nri_angle: Jaipur is a first stop on most diaspora winter trips to India; monument footfall already at peak levels tells visiting families to book early and start Amer Fort at opening time.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Chicago's Field Museum Hosts Diwali Celebration With Dance, Diyas and Ayurveda on November 15
articles.excerpt: The museum's Cultural Programming series marks the festival of lights on Sunday, November 15, from 12:30 to 5 p.m., with classical dance, Bollywood performances, henna, diya decorating, and two science sessions — all included with admission.
articles.nri_angle: A family-friendly Diwali programme at one of Chicago's major museums gives the region's Indian community a public celebration the Sunday after the festival.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.label: Venue
items.value: 1400 S DuSable Lake Shore Dr, Chicago, IL 60605

articles.title: Airlines Cut Diwali Flights For First Time Since Covid As Fares Surge
articles.excerpt: Cirium data reported by Bloomberg put October–November scheduled flights about 6% below a year earlier, while a separate weekly domestic count also fell — with fares on some routes doubling in effect.
articles.image_caption: Airlines
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora travellers heading to India for Diwali face fewer flights and higher fares on thinner routes, and should recheck schedules before travelling.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Air India to Shift More Europe, US Flights to Mumbai, Eyes Bengaluru as Third Hub
articles.excerpt: CEO Tewolde Gebremariam said Pakistan's airspace closure hits Delhi harder than Mumbai, so westbound growth will move to Mumbai, eastern growth will stay in Delhi, and Bengaluru is being explored as a third hub.
articles.nri_angle: For US- and Europe-based NRIs, the rebalance means more long-haul choice from Mumbai over time and a possible Bengaluru long-haul hub — but no route has been announced or moved yet, so existing bookings are unaffected by this statement alone.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.label: Fuel Prices Compared to Last Year

articles.title: Air India App Gets Split-View Layouts Tailored for Apple's iPhone Duo
articles.excerpt: Air India says its app was ready for the iPhone Duo from day one, with split-view and dual-pane layouts for booking, My Trips, check-in, flight status and loyalty.
articles.image_caption: Air India
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora travellers using an iPhone Duo can compare Air India flights and manage trips side by side on the unfolded display.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Goa's Palolem Named Best Beach In Asia, Sixth Globally, State Government Says
articles.excerpt: Hindustan Times reported the state government saying Palolem was named best in Asia and sixth globally; the beach is in Canacona, South Goa.
articles.image_caption: Visitors walk along the sand at Palolem Beach in South Goa, with palm trees lining the shore. The state government said Palolem was named the best beach in Asia and ranked sixth globally, as reported by Hindustan Times.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora travellers adding Goa to an India trip, Palolem in South Goa offers a specific, reachable beach option about 40 minutes from Margao.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Drone Show and Fireworks Cap Edison's Fifth Annual Diwali Festival of Lights
articles.excerpt: The Papaianni Park celebration, themed 'Celebrating Diwali in America 250,' paired a diya lighting, dances and food stalls with a Patel Brothers-sponsored aerial finale in a township with one of New Jersey's largest Indian communities.
articles.nri_angle: Edison, home to one of New Jersey's largest Asian Indian populations, stages one of the state's biggest public Diwali celebrations — a flagship community event for the diaspora in the New York metro area.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items: Diwali Festival of Lights on November 7, 2-9 p.m.

articles.title: Hyderabad Marks Diwali in Many Ways, From Bommala Koluvu to Kali Puja
articles.excerpt: On Sunday, November 8, Telugu doll displays, Bengali Kali Puja, Maharashtrian oil baths and traders' new-year pujas converge on the lit lanes around Charminar.
articles.image_caption: Lit earthen diyas arranged on a decorated plate with marigold and rose petals. Hyderabad marks Diwali on Sunday, November 8, with Lakshmi Puja in the evening.
articles.nri_angle: For Hyderabadis abroad, this is a map of the Diwali they grew up with — and for diaspora visitors in the city this weekend, a practical route through it.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Hijack Threat Note Forces IndiGo Bengaluru-Lucknow Flight to Turn Back
articles.excerpt: Flight 6E 451 with 178 passengers returned to Kempegowda airport after a threat note was found in the lavatory; a 90-minute search declared it a hoax and the flight later departed.
articles.image_caption: An IndiGo aircraft in flight, shown over the terminal interior of Kempegowda International Airport in Bengaluru. Flight 6E 451 returned to the airport on Saturday after a hijack threat note was found on board.
articles.nri_angle: Bengaluru is a primary gateway for diaspora travellers connecting through India; a full-emergency return is a reminder to protect connection times on India domestic legs.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Parliamentary Panel Presses IndiGo and Air India as Airlines Blame Fuel and Closed Skies
articles.excerpt: The Committee on Public Undertakings, chaired by Baijayant Panda, questioned both carriers on November 2. IndiGo pointed to a Rs 1,879.1 crore quarterly loss and Air India to longer, costlier routings around Pakistan's closed airspace.

sources.label: Telegraph India (candidate source via Google News)

articles.nri_angle: India fares are the single largest cost of a diaspora trip home; with both major carriers telling Parliament that fuel and the Pakistan airspace closure keep costs up, and no cap or relief announced, winter-season fares should be planned at current levels.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.label: IndiGo's fuel cost per available seat km increase

articles.title: Pleasant Hill Lights Up Tonight With Diwali Night Market Celebration
articles.excerpt: The Chilpancingo Park market marks the Festival of Lights on Friday, November 6, 2026, from 5 to 9 p.m., with an illuminated sculpture show, live performances, a DJ and family activities.
articles.image_caption: Diwali
articles.nri_angle: A public Diwali celebration in Contra Costa County gives East Bay Indian diaspora families a local, neighbourhood way to mark the Festival of Lights with their wider community.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.event: Last Night Market of the season

articles.title: Air India Launches Maharaja Shop, Turning Loyalty Points Into Everyday Shopping
articles.excerpt: The members-only marketplace lets Maharaja Club members earn points on electronics, luggage, jewellery and exclusive Air India merchandise, redeemable for award flights and upgrades.
articles.image_caption: Loyalty
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora Maharaja Club members can now build points for US-India award flights through everyday shopping, not only flying, via Air India's members-only store.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: A Diwali Ticket Home Now Costs Up to Rs 2.5 Lakh From London
articles.excerpt: Fares from the Gulf to Hyderabad are up over 400 percent as workers who skipped trips during months of regional unrest all head home for the festival at once.
articles.nri_angle: The Gulf is home to millions of Indian workers whose Diwali trip is a three-to-five-day dash home; a 400 percent fare surge decides whether many of them go at all.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Air India Restores Nonstop Delhi and Mumbai to New York Flights as Iraq Airspace Reopens
articles.excerpt: The Rome fuel stop is gone on four routes to JFK and Newark, cutting journeys from almost 20 hours to 15-16 — though January headwinds could bring stops back.
articles.nri_angle: Delhi and Mumbai to New York is among the busiest diaspora corridors in the world; four hours saved and a layover removed changes the trip for thousands of Diwali-season travellers.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Where Niagara Residents Can Set Off Fireworks for Diwali, City by City
articles.excerpt: Niagara Falls permits Diwali fireworks November 7-11 and St. Catharines November 7-9, each with strict hours and private-property rules. Welland's bylaw does not list Diwali, and Thorold requires the Fire Chief's written approval for other holidays.
articles.nri_angle: Ontario's Niagara region has a growing South Asian community, and its Diwali fireworks rules differ sharply by municipality — Niagara Falls and St. Catharines permit them on set dates, while Welland and Thorold do not permit a Diwali display as of right.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Ekta Nagar's Glow Garden and 1.5-Crore-Light Display Draw Diwali-Week Families
articles.excerpt: An upgraded Unity Glow Garden, a 530-metre illuminated stretch and a 180-metre Glow Tunnel anchor Ekta Prakash Parv at the Statue of Unity, while Bharat Parv runs until November 15 and the statue stays open on Monday, November 9.
articles.nri_angle: Ekta Nagar's upgraded glow garden and light festival give diaspora families visiting Gujarat for Diwali a concrete after-dark itinerary at the Statue of Unity, including a special Monday opening on November 9.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Air India Courts UK Travel Trade in London During World Travel Market
articles.excerpt: The airline hosted diaspora-heavy UK travel sellers with Tourism Minister Shekhawat, building on its new tourism-promotion MoU with the ministry.
articles.image_caption: The London skyline. Air India hosted UK travel trade leaders in the capital on the sidelines of World Travel Market London.
articles.nri_angle: Much of the UK-India travel trade in the room is diaspora-run, and the push targets the VFR and heritage travel diaspora families book every year.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.event: Air India event with UK travel leaders

articles.title: Edmonton Warns Diwali Fireworks Without Permit Are Illegal, Fines Reach $10,000
articles.excerpt: Only certified professionals with a city permit may launch fireworks in Edmonton. For Diwali, a free permitted display runs at Mill Woods Park on Sunday, November 8, with fireworks at 8:30 p.m.
articles.image_caption: Fireworks burst over the night sky during a public display. Edmonton allows only certified professionals with a city permit to launch fireworks, with fines of up to $10,000 for unpermitted use.

sources.label: City of Edmonton — Firework Permits and Safety
ToDo Canada — United Edmonton Diwali & Bandi Chhor Diwas event listing

articles.nri_angle: Edmonton's South Asian families get a clear Diwali plan: no home fireworks without a professional permit, and a free city-backed display at Mill Woods Park on November 8 instead.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.event: Diwali Celebration at Mill Woods Park

articles.title: Air India Suspends Delhi-Birmingham Nonstop Flights for Winter Season
articles.excerpt: The three-times-weekly Delhi-Birmingham service is withdrawn from November 4, 2026 for winter 2026-27. Amritsar-Birmingham and four-daily Delhi-Heathrow remain the main Air India alternatives, and ticket holders should check rebooking and refund options now.

sources.label: Live From A Lounge — Air India Cuts Four European Routes as Winter Schedule Changes Take Effect
Simple Flying — Air India Cancels All Flights To 8 Destinations

articles.nri_angle: For the West Midlands' large South Asian community, the loss of the Delhi nonstop means re-routing via Amritsar, Heathrow or a hub this winter, starting with checking any November 4-onward booking.

articles.title: Six Affordable International Trips for the Diwali Long Weekend
articles.excerpt: From Kathmandu from Rs 8,596 to Hanoi, Colombo, Bangkok, Tashkent and Baku, two Diwali guides map six short-haul breaks that fit the Nov. 6-11 festival window — with 'from' fares and full-trip budgets as the sources state them.
articles.image_caption: Boats are moored at a floating market lit by string lights at sunset. Thailand is one of six destinations listed with 'from' fares for the Diwali long weekend.

sources.label: Market Dot News — Make the Most of Diwali with Skyscanner's Flight Offers
Curly Tales — 8 International Destinations For A Diwali Getaway Under Rs 50,000

articles.nri_angle: For diaspora readers timing a Diwali trip home to India, these six short-haul breaks offer an affordable add-on escape within the same Nov. 6-11 festival window.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Air India Wants More Wide-Body Jets, Eyes Profitability Very Soon
articles.excerpt: New CEO Tewolde Gebremariam says the existing order book is not enough for the airline's network ambitions, as costs, losses and airspace closures squeeze the Tata Group turnaround.
articles.image_caption: Air India chief executive Tewolde Gebremariam speaks at an industry event. Gebremariam said the airline is seeking more wide-body aircraft and expects to reach profitability 'very soon.'
articles.nri_angle: For the diaspora, a larger wide-body fleet and a possible Bengaluru hub would mean more long-haul capacity and better connections between India and the U.S., Europe and the Gulf.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Rare Annapurna Darshan Opens in Kashi for Dhanteras and Diwali 2026
articles.excerpt: The special murti at Varanasi's Annapurna Temple, beside Kashi Vishwanath, is open only around Dhanteras and Annakut — November 6 to 11 in 2026, with Annakut on November 10.
articles.image_caption: The Kashi Vishwanath temple complex in Varanasi, with its gold-plated spire. The adjoining Annapurna temple opens its rare annual darshan to devotees during the Dhanteras and Diwali period.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora visitors travelling to India for Diwali, the rare Annapurna darshan window is November 6 to 11, 2026, with Dhanteras on November 6 and Annakut on November 10.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Abu Dhabi Pitches Two, Four and Seven-Day Diwali Getaways
articles.excerpt: DCT Abu Dhabi has published Diwali itineraries built around Yas Island, Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Saadiyat and the desert — a three-to-four-hour flight from major Indian cities, with prices and offers left to its official campaign page.
articles.image_caption: Four
articles.nri_angle: A three-to-four-hour flight from major Indian cities makes Abu Dhabi a realistic Diwali-week option for India-based families and a stopover add-on for diaspora travellers routing through the Gulf.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: IndiGo Leans on Mumbai and Premium Cabins as Pakistan Airspace Closure Disrupts Westward Flights
articles.excerpt: With Delhi's westward routes squeezed by the closure of Pakistani airspace and jet fuel prices elevated, IndiGo CEO Willie Walsh says the airline will push European growth through Mumbai, keep its Amsterdam slots with the A321XLR, and go premium on the A350 from 2028.
articles.image_caption: The Bandra-Worli Sea Link crosses Mahim Bay in Mumbai. IndiGo said Mumbai offers room to add European destinations while Delhi westward routes face disruption from the closure of Pakistani airspace.
articles.nri_angle: IndiGo's Mumbai-led European push and its planned lie-flat A350 cabins from 2028 mean more nonstop India-Europe options for diaspora travellers who currently connect through Gulf or European hubs.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Karnataka Takes Tourism Roadshows to Manchester, London and Birmingham
articles.excerpt: Led by Tourism Minister Kelachandra Joseph George, the UK programme pairs WTM London with diaspora-city roadshows as the state works to revive declining NRI footfall, The Hindu reported.
articles.image_caption: The London skyline at dusk, with Tower Bridge over the Thames. Karnataka Tourism exhibits at World Travel Market London from November 3 to 5, 2026, between roadshows in Manchester and Birmingham.
articles.nri_angle: The Birmingham and Manchester stops put the pitch in two of Britain's biggest South Asian diaspora cities, aimed at NRIs who combine family visits with touring.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Seven Places to See Diwali at Its Brightest, From Ayodhya's Deepotsav to Amritsar
articles.excerpt: Diwali falls on Sunday, November 8, 2026. Ayodhya, Varanasi, Jaipur, Amritsar, Kolkata, Goa and Udaipur each celebrate differently — here is what each does best and how to choose.
articles.image_caption: The Golden Temple (Sri Harmandir Sahib) in Amritsar, seen across the sarovar. Amritsar marks Diwali alongside Bandi Chhor Divas, when the temple is illuminated for the festival.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora families timing an India trip to the festival, Diwali on Sunday, November 8 makes a long weekend; book the Ayodhya and Varanasi legs early and keep Dev Deepawali's separate date in mind.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Saudi Carriers Add India Flights as Indian Airlines Extend Suspensions to November 14
articles.excerpt: Flynas is adding services from Dammam to six Indian cities and from Riyadh to three, the Indian Consulate in Jeddah said, while Air India, IndiGo and Akasa keep most Saudi routes suspended.
articles.nri_angle: For the millions of Indians working in Saudi Arabia and Umrah pilgrims, the working options right now are Saudi carriers and one-stop routings; Indian-carrier tickets need rebooking or refunds.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indians Can Now Book Burj Khalifa, Sentosa Tickets Online Using UPI
articles.excerpt: UPI payments are enabled for online bookings at At the Top, Burj Khalifa and Resorts World Sentosa attractions including Universal Studios Singapore, the Finance Ministry said.
articles.image_caption: The Burj Khalifa towers over the Dubai skyline. Indian travellers can now book tickets for the Burj Khalifa and Singapore's Resorts World Sentosa attractions online using UPI.

articles.nri_angle: Helps diaspora families and India-based relatives plan Dubai and Singapore trips by paying for two headline attractions in rupees through UPI before departure.

articles.title: Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper Bookings Open, Fares Start at Rs 2,810
articles.excerpt: The first regular train leaves Bengaluru at 7:45 p.m. on November 3 and Mumbai on November 2, with confirmed berths only and full-route fares from Rs 2,810 to Rs 4,450.
articles.image_caption: The Vande Bharat Sleeper trainset at a platform and a view of its sleeper berths. Regular services between Bengaluru and Mumbai begin in the first week of November with fares starting at Rs 2,810.
articles.nri_angle: Gives diaspora travellers visiting India a faster overnight option between Bengaluru and Mumbai, with the fares, dates and confirmed-only booking rules they need before they fly in.
